_README: SET THIS UP BEFORE YOUR FIRST PORT. Shared configuration for
template_port.py and utils/verify_port_signoff.py so the sign-off name and
the ban list live in exactly one place.
signoff_name: the name that must appear under 'Sincerely,' at the end of
every cover body. Both scripts fail closed while this is the placeholder.
Canva silently clips trailing text out of a too-small fixed-height box, so
this guard is what stops an unsigned cover from shipping.
cover_char_band: [min, max] characters for a cover that fills the page
without overflowing. RECALIBRATE against your own layout: draft one cover
at the top of the band, render it, and adjust until it fills the page.
banned_phrases: regex fragments that FAIL the run. Add one every time you
catch a phrase that isn't yours, so you never have to correct it twice.
banned_allow: regexes that re-permit a full match caught by banned_phrases
banned_phrases: I would welcome the opportunity to leverage
